extDesc.message: Select any area of a page and search it with Google Lens.

menuSearch.description: Context menu entry that starts area selection.

menuSearchImage.description: Context menu entry shown on images.

overlayClose.description: Close button tooltip on the selection overlay.

overlayCaptureError.message: Unable to capture this area. Try selecting it again.
overlayCaptureError.description: Error shown on the overlay when the selected area could not be captured.

overlayIncognitoUnavailable.message: Google Lens could not be opened or the image could not be submitted in incognito. Check G+Lens incognito access and your connection, then try again. Search will not fall back to a normal window.
overlayIncognitoUnavailable.description: Error shown when Google Lens cannot be opened or submitted to in an incognito window.

viewerOffline.description: Status when the pre-check cannot reach Google.

viewerOpenTab.description: Open the same search in a new tab.

viewerNoImage.message: No screenshot to search. Capture an area first.
viewerNoImage.description: Shown when the popup is opened without a pending capture.

optionsResultGroup.description: Options section heading for result window behaviour.

optionsCloseLabel.message: Close the selection overlay with the result window

optionsCloseHint.message: When on, closing the result window also ends area selection and returns you to the page.

optionsSelectionGroup.description: Options section heading for selection behavior.

optionsScrollLabel.description: Options checkbox label for scrolling during selection.

optionsScrollHint.message: Keep the page dimmed while scrolling; the current view is captured after you select an area.
optionsScrollHint.description: Options checkbox hint for scrolling during selection.

optionsIncognitoLabel.description: Options checkbox label for incognito search.

optionsIncognitoHint.message: [Experiment] Separating the Google login status in Lens from that of the standard browser. Due to browser limitations, the current implementation is somewhat rudimentary.
optionsIncognitoHint.description: Options checkbox hint for incognito search.

optionsIncognitoAccess.message: To use incognito search, allow G+Lens in incognito mode on its extension details page, then quit Brave completely, including background processes, and restart it.
optionsIncognitoAccess.description: Guidance shown when the extension is not allowed in incognito.

optionsIncognitoAccessButton.description: Button that opens G+Lens extension details.

optionsIncognitoAccessCheckError.message: Could not verify incognito access. Open extension settings to check the permission.
optionsIncognitoAccessCheckError.description: Fallback guidance when checking incognito access fails.

optionsIncognitoOpenError.message: Could not open extension settings. Open the browser extensions page and enable incognito access for G+Lens.
optionsIncognitoOpenError.description: Error shown when extension details could not be opened.

optionsShortcutGroup.description: Options section heading for the keyboard shortcut.

optionsShortcutChange.description: Button that opens the browser shortcut page.

optionsShortcutHint.message: Chromium only allows changing this in the browser’s own extension shortcuts page.
optionsShortcutHint.description: Explains why the shortcut cannot be edited inline.

optionsShortcutEmpty.message: No shortcut is assigned. Use “Change in browser” to pick one.
optionsShortcutEmpty.description: Shown when the shortcut is unassigned.

optionsNotAssigned.description: Shortcut placeholder when nothing is assigned.

optionsSaved.description: Transient confirmation after changing a setting.

optionsSettingsError.message: Could not load or save settings.
optionsSettingsError.description: Error shown when extension settings cannot be read or saved.
